Name: Azariah, Son of Jehalelel
Summary: Azariah, son of Jehalelel of the sons of Merari, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi and Azariah the son of Jehalelel arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Jehalelel, Father of Azariah; King Hezekiah
LifeLesson: Every Levite clan had a part in restoring worship.
